memory_annotations.evidence_summary: Marcus narrowed the Phoenix trip to one Monday evening nonstop outbound and two Wednesday return candidates based on whether the Chandler meeting ends at 4:00 or 6:00. No recurring preference was established and nothing was booked.

messages.content: I need flights for a Phoenix opening review. I have to be at the first walkthrough in Chandler at 9:00 Tuesday morning, so I think I should fly out Monday evening. The last meeting is supposed to end at 4:00 Wednesday, but it could run late.
What Monday and Wednesday dates are we working with, and should I search from both Chicago airports or just O'Hare?
Monday, January 12, returning Wednesday, January 14. Use O'Hare. I want a nonstop outbound that gets me in with enough time to get to a Chandler hotel and sleep.

I found three nonstop Monday departures. The best fit is American 2826, leaving ORD at 6:10 p.m. and arriving PHX at 9:03 p.m., for $428 round trip when paired with the earlier Wednesday return. There is also a 7:45 p.m. United flight arriving at 10:38 p.m. for $401, and a 9:05 p.m. American flight arriving at 11:58 p.m. for $367.
Keep the 6:10 American flight. What does that arrival actually mean for getting to Chandler?

Allow about 20 to 30 minutes to deplane and reach the rideshare pickup area if you have only a carry-on. The drive from PHX to central Chandler is usually 25 to 35 minutes that late, so a realistic hotel arrival is 10:00 to 10:20 p.m. That leaves a comfortable margin before a 9:00 a.m. walkthrough.
Good. Now compare Wednesday returns. Assume the meeting is in Chandler and show me one that works if we finish at 4:00 and one that still works if it goes to 6:00.

For a 4:00 p.m. finish, American 2811 departs PHX at 7:35 p.m. and arrives ORD at 11:59 p.m. The round trip with your Monday outbound is $428. Leaving Chandler around 4:15 should put you at PHX between 4:45 and 5:15, giving you at least 2 hours 20 minutes before departure.

United 1732 leaves PHX at 9:45 p.m. and reaches ORD at 1:58 a.m. Thursday. Combining separate outbound and return tickets would total $462. If the meeting ends at 6:00, a departure from Chandler around 6:15 should get you to PHX between 6:45 and 7:25, leaving roughly 2 hours 20 minutes even at the slower end.
Are there any nonstop flights between those two that would be less painful than getting home at 2:00 a.m.?

There is an American departure at 8:30 p.m., arriving ORD at 12:54 a.m., for a $447 round trip. It works well after a 4:00 finish, but it is not dependable if the meeting runs to 6:00. A 6:15 departure from Chandler could leave only about an hour at the airport after traffic, rideshare drop-off, and security.
Then do not treat 8:30 as the late-meeting option. Is the 7:35 return reasonable with rental-car return, or only with rideshare?

It is reasonable with rideshare. With a rental car, I would leave Chandler by 4:00 because fueling, the rental return, and the Sky Train can add 30 to 45 minutes. If the meeting truly ends at 4:00, that makes the 7:35 flight tighter than it first appears.

I have not decided on the car or hotel yet. Hold the 6:10 Monday outbound, the 7:35 Wednesday return for the normal schedule, and the 9:45 return if the team confirms a late meeting. Do not book anything.

Held for the next decision: American 2826 on Monday, January 12, ORD 6:10 p.m. to PHX 9:03 p.m.; American 2811 on Wednesday, January 14, PHX 7:35 p.m. to ORD 11:59 p.m., at $428 round trip; and United 1732 at 9:45 p.m. to ORD 1:58 a.m. Thursday as the late-meeting alternative, totaling $462 with the American outbound. Nothing has been booked. The hotel location and whether you use a rental car or rideshare will determine how comfortable the 7:35 return is.

They should reach SEA around 9:50 a.m. Sunday and expect to arrive home in Chicago around 7:05 to 7:30 p.m. For the Phoenix opening review in Chandler, no travel is booked. The candidates are American 2826 on Monday, January 12, ORD 6:10 p.m. to PHX 9:03 p.m.; American 2811 on Wednesday, January 14, PHX 7:35 p.m. to ORD 11:59 p.m. if the meeting ends at 4:00; and United 1732 at 9:45 p.m. to ORD 1:58 a.m. Thursday if it runs to 6:00. Hotel location, ground transportation, and the final Wednesday meeting time remain unresolved.
